services.desc: The Waves Roller Rink was built in the early 1920’s by Ray Walker and operated as a skating rink through the 1930’s during the war years and into the 1950’s. In its earliest years the skating rink was also used one day a week as a silent movie theatre with Miss Weeks accompanying on the piano. Folding chairs were placed on top of the rink for seating and adults paid 15 cents and children paid 10 cents. In the mid-1960’s Richard and Margaret Atherton bought the Roller Rink building with the dream of turning it into a theatre.
